headline: Indian stock markets trade higher with Sensex up and Nifty around 25,200 supported by FII inflows

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Market rally was backed by continued foreign fund inflows (FII inflows)
Lower crude oil prices helped boost overall investor sentiment
Strong buying interest seen in major stocks like ITC, Bharti Airtel, and Asian Paints
Gains in the Nifty FMCG sector contributed positively to benchmark indices
whatHappening: Sensex gained up to 719 points in early trade while Nifty crossed 25,200 levels
ITC shares rose by 3%, while Laurus Labs dropped 8% during market hours
Tata Steel's CEO indicated expectations of a stronger performance in the second half of the fiscal year
Small and mid-cap stocks underperformed relative to the headline benchmark indices
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty traded higher today, driven by foreign fund inflows and lower crude oil prices. Key gainers included ITC, Bharti Airtel, and Asian Paints, while Laurus Labs faced selling pressure. Tata Steel expressed optimism for a stronger second-half performance.
